instruction.name: xvbitseti.d
instruction.description: For each 64-bit element, set the bit indexed by `imm`, save the result in `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 2.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvbitseti.d $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvbitseti.d $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvbitseti.d $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvbitseti.d $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvbitseti.d $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvbitseti.d $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvbitseti.d $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvbitseti.d $xr7, $xr15, 1
